title: Design: long and special tier names in the simulator headers
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a long name with spaces that no other record of that kind has, at least 50 characters (for example Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment Fleet Pricing Plan).
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a long name with no spaces, at least 50 characters (for example NorthernAlbertaHeavyEquipmentFleetPricingPlanTier).
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier C, with a name with the characters & " ' < > in it (for example A&B "Fleet" O'Neil <Tier>).
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Point at tier B's header in the simulator.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Matrices list shows.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's, tier B's and tier C's simulator columns stay lined up under their grid columns.
  • Each name stays inside its own column heading and never covers the next column.
  • Every price stays visible and the page does not scroll sideways.
  • Tier C's name shows character for character as typed, & " ' < > included.

Step 3:

  • Tier B's full name shows on hover.
